title: lastrea cruciata
intro: Lastrea cruciata, commonly known as the Cross-leaved Fern or Cross-leaved Spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea cruciata include its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve respiratory issues, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties. Furthermore, studies have shown that Lastrea cruciata may also exhibit antimicrobial and antiproliferative activities, making it a promising candidate for further research and development.
